_comment: Canonical Organization document shape. client is the authority - it creates and owns this document in SQLite. Organizations group users for RBAC and resource isolation. In single-user deployments, organization_id equals user_id. A field mismatch breaks multi-tenant routing and RBAC enforcement.

organization._description: Organization document. Groups users for role-based access control and resource isolation. Auto-created for single-user deployments.

id.description: Unique organization identifier (UUID v4). Equals user_id for single-user orgs.

name.description: Display name for the organization. Defaults to the owner's email prefix for single-user orgs.

owner_user_id.description: User ID of the organization owner.

member_user_ids.description: User IDs of all organization members. Includes the owner.

plan_type.description: Subscription plan type. See status.json organization.plan.

max_operators.description: Maximum number of Operator slots allowed for this organization.

max_users.description: Maximum number of users allowed in this organization.
